shots.notes: LAST CALL, one moment: the gold VIP ticket for the night-shift nurse at two of two, her cold dish ready on the plate, noodles steaming in the wok, cold counter with bowl and sesame bottle, menu board with No Wok badge, shift timer and coins visible.

shots.name: 2-chop.jpg
shots.notes: The journey begins: the VIP ticket just arrived, nothing done yet, her greens on the chop board, cook mid-chop.

shots.name: 3-cold.jpg
shots.notes: Mid-journey: the VIP's chili is chopped and on the plate, her greens mid-toss at the cold counter, noodles steaming in wok 1 for the next hot ticket, cook at the cold counter.

shots.name: 4-serve.jpg
shots.notes: The payoff: the VIP's cold plate complete, serve mid-flight with the +$45 PERFECT popup, cook beside the plate (the hatch approach would put him on the cold counter).
